name: Marble Canyon
shortDescription: Roll a glass marble down a canyon track against your own ghost.
description: A marble time trial in the browser. A glass marble rolls down a banked ribbon track through a sandstone canyon, with jumps, boost pads, and three checkpoint gates. Steer by dragging on a phone or with the arrow keys on a computer. Every run after your first races a translucent ghost of your best, saved in your browser. The canyon is built from a word you choose, so your hosted copy has its own track, and the gold, silver, and bronze times come from the track's length. Pick a short, medium, or long canyon, the color of the swirl inside the marble, and one of three looks: canyon, ice, or neon, each with a daytime and an evening version.
